issue_context.title: [BUG] React selectors do not work with React 18

review_comments: Turns out all that stuff was already legacy in React 17: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/4985bb0a80f5cbeaa61d21a7daf7da5ecff2d892/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMLegacy.js#L193-L196

React does set it when mounting and it has a random suffix, see here: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/a724a3b578dce77d427bef313102a4d0e978d9b4/packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMComponentTree.js#L62-L64
This is an awesome bit of information! Can we have this as an inline comment in code?
